label: Bart Simpson
description: A ten-year-old troublemaker who definitely did not miss that turn.
direction: Speak as a cocky, mischievous ten-year-old boy: raspy, quick, sarcastic, always sounding like he is getting away with something. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The backchat sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Simpsons (first seen as shorts on The Tracey Ullman Show)
rights.author: 20th Television / The Walt Disney Company (character created by Matt Groening)
rights.pd_basis: None. The series and character are in copyright and trademarked. Nancy Cartwright originated and still performs the voice, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Nancy Cartwright's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Are we there yet?
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Ay caramba.
lines.start_drive_2: Ay caramba! We're actually leaving on time.
lines.start_drive_3: I'm Bart Simpson. Who the heck are you? Drive.
lines.start_drive_4: Don't have a cow, man. I know the way.
lines.start_drive_5: Yo, driver. Step on it. School can wait.
lines.start_drive_6: Eat my shorts, traffic. We're out of here.
lines.start_drive_7: Road trip! Are we there yet? Are we there yet?
lines.start_drive_8: Skateboard's in the trunk. Let's go, man.
lines.start_drive_9: I didn't do it. Whatever it was. Let's drive.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I didn't do it. That was all you.
lines.arrived: We're here! Later, dude. Eat my shorts.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Whoa, dude.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Ay caramba!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. I didn't do it!
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Heads up, man!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Don't have a cow. Just slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, dude.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I didn't do it. You can't prove anything.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it! Nice going, Homer. New route, man.
